'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Aaron Kingery LS Echo Base Operations''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Kingery]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Echo Base Operations / General Dodonna]]
* '''Username:''' Archmage
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
